
===== getCrimesStageLabel =====
function getCrimesStageLabel() {
    const { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons } = getStageButtons();
    const btns = stageButtons?.length ? stageButtons : [recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn].filter(Boolean);
    const active = btns.find(isActiveStageButton) || btns.find(b => {
      const aria = String(b.getAttribute("aria-selected") || b.getAttribute("aria-current") || "").toLowerCase();
      return aria === "true" || aria === "page";
    });
    const txt = (active?.textContent || "").trim();
    if (/recruit/i.test(txt)) return "Recruiting";
    if (/plan/i.test(txt)) return "Planning";
    if (/compl/i.test(txt)) return "Completed";
    return txt || "Unknown";
  }

===== getStageButtons =====
function getStageButtons() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    const pool = bar
      ? Array.from(bar.querySelectorAll("button, [role='tab'], [role='button']")).filter(isStageButton)
      : candidateStageButtons();
    let recruitingBtn = null;
    let planningBtn = null;
    let completedBtn = null;
    for (const btn of pool) {
      const t = stageButtonText(btn);
      if (!recruitingBtn && /recruit/.test(t)) recruitingBtn = btn;
      if (!planningBtn && /plan/.test(t)) planningBtn = btn;
      if (!completedBtn && /complet/.test(t)) completedBtn = btn;
    }
    return { recruitingBtn, planningBtn, completedBtn, stageButtons: pool };
  }

===== getTabsBar =====
function getTabsBar() {
    const oldBar = document.querySelector("div.buttonsContainer___aClaa");
    if (oldBar && oldBar.querySelector("button")) return oldBar;
    const buttons = candidateStageButtons();
    return commonStageBarFromButtons(buttons);
  }

===== getNotInvolvedCards =====
function getNotInvolvedCards() {
    const box = getNotInvolvedBox();
    if (!box) return [];

    const profileLinks = Array.from(
      box.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]')
    );

    const seen = new Set();
    const cards = [];

    for (const link of profileLinks) {
      const xid = xidFromHref(link.getAttribute("href"));
      if (!xid || seen.has(String(xid))) continue;
      seen.add(String(xid));

      const row =
        link.closest('li[class*="item"]') ||
        link.closest("li") ||
        link.closest('[class*="member"]') ||
        link.closest('[class*="item"]') ||
        link.parentElement ||
        box;

      const honorImg =
        row.querySelector?.('img[alt]') ||
        link.querySelector?.('img[alt]');

      const plainHonor = Array.from(
        row.querySelectorAll?.("span.honor-text") || []
      )
        .map(el => (el.textContent || "").trim())
        .find(Boolean);

      const symbolName = Array.from(
        row.querySelectorAll?.('[class*="honorTextSymbol"]') || []
      )
        .map(el => el.dataset.char || "")
        .join("")
        .trim();

      const ariaName = String(
        link.getAttribute("aria-label") || ""
      )
        .replace(/^View profile of\s+/i, "")
        .trim();

      const linkText = String(link.textContent || "")
        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
        .trim();

      const name =
        honorImg?.getAttribute("alt")?.trim() ||
        plainHonor ||
        symbolName ||
        ariaName ||
        linkText ||
        `Member #${xid}`;

      cards.push({ li: row, link, xid: String(xid), name });
    }

    return cards;
  }

===== scanCurrentCrimesStage =====
function scanCurrentCrimesStage() {
    const stage = getCrimesStageLabel();
    refreshNotInOCFromPage();
    if (stage !== "Recruiting" && stage !== "Planning") {
      return { ok: false, stage, reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning" };
    }
    const usersInOC = new Set();
    const reqByUser = {};
    const roleByUser = {};
    const roots = findSlotRoots();
    for (const root of roots) {
      let xid = directSlotXid(root);
      if (!xid) {
        xid = await openMenuAndGetXid(root);
      }
      if (!xid) continue;
      usersInOC.add(xid);
      if (!reqByUser[xid]) {
        reqByUser[xid] = [];
      }

      const roleName =
        (
          root.querySelector(
            '[class*="title"], [class*="role"]'
          )?.textContent ||
          ""
        )
          .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
          .trim();

      if (roleName) {
        roleByUser[xid] = roleName;
      }

      let itemId = directSlotItemId(root);
      if (!itemId) {
        const hoverHost =
          root.querySelector(
            'button[class*="slotHeader"],[class*="slotHeader"]'
          ) ||
          root.querySelector('[aria-describedby]') ||
          root;
        const tip = await hoverAndGetTooltip(hoverHost);
        itemId = extractItemIdFromTooltip(tip);
      }
      if (isAllowedItemId(itemId)) {
        const sid = String(itemId);
        if (!reqByUser[xid].includes(sid)) {
          reqByUser[xid].push(sid);
        }
      }
    }
    if (!roots.length || !usersInOC.size) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage,
        reason: "No OC role slots found"
      };
    }
    const scan = {
      stage,
      ts: now(),
      source: "dom",
      usersInOC: [...usersInOC],
      reqByUser,
      missingByUser: {},
      roleByUser
    };
    writeScan(scan);
    sessionScanState[stage] = true;
    log("Scan saved:", { stage, users: scan.usersInOC.length });
    return { ok: true, stage, scan };
  }

===== scanAvailableCrimesViaApi =====
function scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
    targetStage = getCrimesStageLabel(),
    force = false
  ) {
    if (
      targetStage !== "Recruiting" &&
      targetStage !== "Planning"
    ) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "Not on Recruiting/Planning"
      };
    }

    const apiKey = getSharedApiKey();
    if (!apiKey) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        stage: targetStage,
        reason: "API key not configured"
      };
    }

    if (
      !force &&
      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] &&
      (now() - apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage]) <
        API_OC_AUTO_SCAN_MS
    ) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        cached: true,
        stage: targetStage
      };
    }

    if (apiOcStagePromises[targetStage]) {
      return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
    }

    apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] = (async () => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        cat: "available",
        limit: "100",
        sort: "ASC"
      });

      const payload =
        await tornApiFetch(
          `/faction/crimes?${query}`,
          apiKey
        );

      const crimes = unwrapCrimeList(payload);
      const byStage = {
        Recruiting: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        },
        Planning: {
          usersInOC: new Set(),
          reqByUser: {},
          missingByUser: {},
          roleByUser: {},
          crimeByUser: {}
        }
      };

      for (const crime of crimes) {
        const stage = apiCrimeStage(crime);
        if (!stage || !byStage[stage]) continue;

        for (const slot of apiCrimeSlots(crime)) {
          const xid = apiSlotUserId(slot);
          if (!xid) continue;

          const stageData = byStage[stage];
          stageData.usersInOC.add(xid);

          const roleName =
            apiSlotRoleName(slot);
          const crimeName =
            apiCrimeName(crime);

          if (roleName) {
            stageData.roleByUser[xid] =
              roleName;
          }
          if (crimeName) {
            stageData.crimeByUser[xid] =
              crimeName;
          }

          const requirement =
            apiSlotRequirement(slot);

          if (!requirement) continue;

          if (!stageData.reqByUser[xid]) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid] = [];
          }
          if (
            !stageData.reqByUser[xid].includes(
              requirement.id
            )
          ) {
            stageData.reqByUser[xid].push(
              requirement.id
            );
          }

          if (requirement.isAvailable === false) {
            if (!stageData.missingByUser[xid]) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid] = [];
            }
            if (
              !stageData.missingByUser[xid].includes(
                requirement.id
              )
            ) {
              stageData.missingByUser[xid].push(
                requirement.id
              );
            }
          }
        }
      }

      const data =
        byStage[targetStage];

      writeScan({
        stage: targetStage,
        ts: now(),
        source: "api",
        usersInOC: [...data.usersInOC],
        reqByUser: data.reqByUser,
        missingByUser: data.missingByUser,
        roleByUser: data.roleByUser,
        crimeByUser: data.crimeByUser
      });

      apiOcStageLastAt[targetStage] = now();

      log("API OC scan saved:", {
        crimes: crimes.length,
        targetStage,
        recruiting: byStage.Recruiting.usersInOC.size,
        planning: byStage.Planning.usersInOC.size
      });

      return {
        ok: true,
        source: "api",
        stage: targetStage,
        crimes: crimes.length
      };
    })()
      .catch(error => {
        log("API OC auto scan failed:", error);
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: error?.message || "API scan failed"
        };
      })
      .finally(() => {
        apiOcStagePromises[targetStage] =
          null;
      });

    return apiOcStagePromises[targetStage];
  }

===== handleOcStageEntry =====
function handleOcStageEntry(
    stage = getCrimesStageLabel()
  ) {
    if (
      !moduleActive ||
      !isCrimesTab() ||
      (
        stage !== "Recruiting" &&
        stage !== "Planning"
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    if (stage === lastObservedOcStage) {
      return;
    }

    // Mark entry immediately so MutationObserver rerenders cannot
    // schedule duplicate API calls while this request is in flight.
    lastObservedOcStage = stage;

    markStageScanRequired(stage);
    updateStageVisuals();

    const statusEl =
      document.querySelector(
        ".sakalux-oco-scan-status"
      );

    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.classList.remove(
        "is-success",
        "is-error"
      );
      statusEl.classList.add(
        "is-scanning"
      );
      statusEl.textContent =
        `Scanning ${stage} members and roles...`;
      statusEl.title =
        `Scanning every ${stage} OC member, role and required item...`;
    }

    const result =
      await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
        stage,
        true
      );

    if (
      result?.ok &&
      result?.stage === stage
    ) {
      markStageScanComplete(stage);
      updateStageVisuals();
      itemTick();
      utilitiesLastSignature = "";

      if (statusEl) {
        flashScanStatus(
          statusEl,
          sessionScanSummary(),
          "success"
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (statusEl) {
      flashScanStatus(
        statusEl,
        result?.reason ||
          "API refresh failed",
        "error",
        2200
      );
    }
  }

===== refreshNotInOCFromPage =====
function refreshNotInOCFromPage() {
    const box = document.querySelector('div[class*="notInvolvedMembers"]');
    if (!box) return { ok: false };
    const xids = Array.from(box.querySelectorAll('a[href*="profiles.php?XID="]'))
      .map(a => xidFromHref(a.getAttribute("href")))
      .filter(Boolean);
    writeNotInOC(xids);
    return { ok: true };
  }

===== ensureScanButton =====
function ensureScanButton() {
    const bar = getTabsBar();
    if (!bar) return;
    if (bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-btn-wrap")) {
      const statusEl = bar.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
      if (statusEl && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-success") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-error") && !statusEl.classList.contains("is-scanning")) {
        renderScanStatus(statusEl);
      }
      updateStageVisuals();
      bindStageAutoRescan();
      return;
    }
    const cs = getComputedStyle(bar);
    if (cs.display !== "flex") {
      bar.style.display = "flex";
      bar.style.alignItems = "center";
    }
    if (!bar.style.gap) bar.style.gap = "6px";
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "sakalux-oco-btn-wrap";
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <button
        id="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        class="sakalux-oco-scan-btn"
        type="button"
        title="Scan this OC stage - scan both Recruiting and Planning for full results."
        aria-label="Scan OC stage"
      >
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M10.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 1 0 4.06 11.58l3.43 3.43 1.41-1.41-3.43-3.43A6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 4Zm0 2a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9 4.5 4.5 0 0 1 0-9Z"/>
        </svg>
        <span>Scan</span>
      </button>
      <span class="sakalux-oco-scan-status" title="${sessionScanTooltip()}">${sessionScanStatusHTML()}</span>
    `;
    bar.appendChild(wrap);
    const btn = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-btn");
    const statusEl = wrap.querySelector(".sakalux-oco-scan-status");
    btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      btn.disabled = true;
      statusEl.classList.remove("is-success", "is-error");
      statusEl.classList.add("is-scanning");
      statusEl.textContent = "Scanning…";
      statusEl.title = "Scanning current OC stage…";
      try {
        const manualStage =
          getCrimesStageLabel();

        if (
          manualStage === "Recruiting" ||
          manualStage === "Planning"
        ) {
          markStageScanRequired(
            manualStage
          );
          updateStageVisuals();
        }

        let result =
          await scanAvailableCrimesViaApi(
            manualStage,
            true
          );

        if (!result?.ok) {
          result =
            await scanCurrentCrimesStage();
        }

        if (!result.ok) {
          flashScanStatus(
            statusEl,
            result.reason || "Go to Recruiting/Planning",
            "error",
            2200
          );
        } else {
          const visibleStage =
            getCrimesStageLabel();

          if (
            visibleStage === "Recruiting" ||
            visibleStage === "Planning"
          ) {
            markStageScanComplete(
              visibleStage
            );
          }

          updateStageVisuals();
          pulseScanBtn(btn);
          itemTick();
          flashScanStatus(statusEl, sessionScanSummary(), "success");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[SakaLuX OC Role Match + Readiness] Scan error:", err);
        flashScanStatus(statusEl, "Scan failed", "error", 2200);
      } finally {
        btn.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    log("Scan button injected.");
    updateStageVisuals();
    bindStageAutoRescan();
  }
